svg.aria-label: Cyber Resilience Act scope decision tree for Java teams. Question 1: do you sell or distribute software in the EU? If no, you are not directly in scope. Question 2: is it exclusively for your own internal use? If yes, out of scope. Question 3: is it software as a service that you host? If yes, generally out of scope. Question 4: is it open source with no paid tier, support or hosting? If yes, out of scope. Question 5: is it custom software built for one client? If yes, in scope. If you answer no to all five, you are a manufacturer under the CRA.

text.font-family: Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Does the Cyber Resilience Act apply to you?

text.font-family: Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Answer each question in order. Stop at the first one that decides your case.
